conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP APM access-policy log (syslog-raw, BSD/RFC3164 only). Builds a message-id dispatch table per recommendations.direct.cribl: parses the stable header (msg id, daemon, pid, access-profile:partition:session-id triple) then a per-message-id extractor for 01490500 (new session), 01490010 (username), 01490102 (policy result), 01490005 (branch rule), 01490113/115 (session variable set, Informational/Debug only). Session-id-to-username stitching and password/token session-variable masking are named in the recommendation but NOT implemented here - no lookup data or masking pattern was supplied in the catalog; recorded as a gap in README.

functions.description: why this pipeline is shaped this way
parse the stable BSD header + profile:partition:sessionid triple shared by every APM access record

conf.regex: /^New session from client IP (?<client_ip>\S+) \(ST=(?<geo_st>[^\/]*)\/CC=(?<geo_cc>[^\/]*)\/C=(?<geo_c>[^)]*)\) at VIP (?<vip>\S+)(?: Listener (?<listener>\S+))?(?: \(Reputation=(?<reputation>[^)]*)\))?/

functions.description: 01490500: client IP, ST/CC/C geolocation triple, VIP, listener and IP-intelligence reputation on the new-session record
01490010: logon name presented to the authentication agent - best-effort label match, exact 01490010 text is not in the catalog, validate against a captured sample
01490102: administrator-named ending the access policy terminated on
01490005: branch rule taken and the policy item it was taken out of
01490113/01490115: session variable set, only emitted when Access Policy log level is Informational or Debug
batch rename every status:mapped field that needs no casting or conditional logic

implement every partial/unmapped transform: numeric casts, daemon-family normalisation with TMM instance kept separately, empty geolocation dropped, policy-result-driven event.outcome defaulted to unknown (no site lookup was supplied), session-variable auth result/agent split, username mirrored to related.user, then drop intermediate parse artifacts

BSD header carries no year or timezone; best-effort current-year/UTC parse into _time per platform constraint 1 (never @timestamp) - true per-device tz correction belongs at the Cribl source, out of scope for a pipeline, recorded as a gap
tag the dataset, hyphen-free per platform constraint 5
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
